fingerprintMethod.sourceScope: app/src recursive files only; test/harness hashes recorded separately per command; source digest is not a build-source attestation for historical runs when parent edited source before next build
fingerprintMethod.finalBuildReuse: Latest nine passing results all target one unchanged v0.3.0 dist; event-ack final-ready supersedes failed final and final-contract runs, not a single all-green batch

findings.actual: Native Chrome 157 did not start extension serviceworker through the historical load-extension flags; wait timed out at15000ms
findings.fix: Migrated all nine assigned tests to existing launchExtension/removeTestProfile harness using Extensions.loadUnpacked and owned child cleanup

findings.actual: GET_STATE.active.status was ready during delayed state cleanup, because immutable evidence seal had already committed; old test expected stopping
findings.fix: Preserve sealed ready state and strengthen same active id/same seal/writeState sealed/UI disabled/direct START rejection/active null after cleanup
findings.outcome: Full final stop-lifecycle passed without reverting terminal state

findings.actual: Persistently unresponsive readonly sessions.get made a later STOP wait forever at the new seal watermark read
findings.fix: Parent bounded background seal watermark get with 5000ms deadline and kept persistent fault injection and original wait bounds
findings.outcome: Final stop-review-regressions all five scenarios passed

findings.actual: Partial acknowledgement expected accepted2/failed1 but got accepted3/failed0; historical put interception never reached append-only add writer
findings.fix: Intercept add; duplicate add calls saved original to avoid recursion; keep partial2/1, rollback0/3, single transaction, good/bad persistence and cross-session assertions
findings.outcome: All preserved acknowledgement and persistence assertions passed in final-ready

findings.actual: Historical warning expected unconfirmed1, but explicit write rejection is known failed1/unknown0
findings.fix: Require warning error matching failed1/unknown0 plus collectorFailedEvents===1 and unknownEvents===0
findings.outcome: Stronger warning/counter assertions passed before final-contract receiver failure and in final-ready

findings.actual: Final fixture suspended CANVAS_OPTIONS but awaited normal START/COLLECTOR_READY for5s; settings timeout shut down collector before test could send STOP_CAPTURE
findings.fix: Only third fixture starts acknowledgeEarly; host <=2000ms verifies isolated-world collector and suspended-settings hook; send unscoped STOP_CAPTURE with reply.ok true before timeout, release settings, preserve no-snapshot/finalSTOP assertions
findings.outcome: event-ack final-ready passed; no further test changes after freeze
